name: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database
description: The MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database contains 48 half-hour excerpts of two-channel ambulatory ECG recordings, obtained from 47 subjects studied by the BIH Arrhythmia Laboratory between 1975 and 1979. The database was the first generally available set of standard test material for evaluation of arrhythmia detectors, with over 109,000 annotated heartbeats validated by cardiologist consensus.
